mobbin:9649cfdc-dbbd-4c86-8a2d-9cdd25395.summary: The user lands on a 'Get started' page showing the plan's remaining minutes. They then open the rooms list to see when each room was last active, its participant minutes and its session count.
steps: Get started: Free plan 2000 participant minutes and create room buttons
Insights Rooms searchable table: name, Last active, 'PM used', Sessions
steal: A plan label on the side always shows the participant minutes left, like a usage budget (screens 1 to 2).
The rooms list shows 'Last active', 'PM used' and 'Sessions' for each room (screen 2).
A small hint on the column header explains Participant Minutes (PM) while you read the number (screen 2).
avoid: The flow opens on a welcome page before the insights; room use should not sit behind a getting-started screen (screen 1).
mobbin:9649cfdc-dbbd-4c86-8a2d-9cdd25395.fit: Reports: a direct match for sim-room use, from the room list to minutes and sessions. It moves Essentials toward room-hour numbers taken from the calendar.

mobbin:df187e39-3913-4484-8e5e-6af9a2f54.summary: The user opens the rooms list, shows the hint that defines Participant Minutes (PM), then opens one room's details with summary boxes and a log of PM per session.
steps: Insights Rooms list: room row with 'PM used' and Sessions
PM hint: Participant Minutes equals sum of participant time
Room details: Sessions, Unique participants, 'PM used', and session table
steal: A hint defines PM right where you read the number (screen 2).
Room details show three headline numbers, then a row per session with duration, participants and 'PM used' (screen 3).
A 'Back to Rooms' link and a room name you can copy sit at the top (screen 3).
mobbin:df187e39-3913-4484-8e5e-6af9a2f54.fit: Reports: the best first-version pattern for room use, from the list to a clearly defined unit of minutes to a log per session, without a report builder.
